subjective.text: Joe Bloggs is fifty four years old with a history of high cholesterol and hypertension.
Joe Bloggs experiences chest discomfort that feels like someone sitting on his chest for the past few hours.
Joe Bloggs has shortness of breath and feels light-headed.
Joe Bloggs experiences difficulty climbing stairs and walking uphill.
Joe Bloggs has nausea but no vomiting.
Joe Bloggs lives with his wife and does not have any other medical problems.
Joe Bloggs has no history of heart issues or chest pain prior to this incident.

objective.text: No physical examination findings were mentioned during the consultation.

assessment.text: Joe Bloggs is experiencing chest discomfort and shortness of breath that may be related to his heart or lungs, given his history of high blood pressure and cholesterol.
Joe Bloggs should call an ambulance due to the severity and potential seriousness of his symptoms.

plan.text: Joe Bloggs should stay calm and have water available. Do not take any medications.
The ambulance will arrive soon to transport Joe Bloggs to the hospital for further evaluation of his heart and lungs.
Joe Bloggs should be seen by a consultant at the hospital as soon as possible after arrival.
